audit_items.proof_trace: The boundary check uses strict inequality (blob_retention_epoch > fulu_fork_epoch) at line 828 instead of >= as required. At exactly current_epoch == FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS, the condition fails and blobs remain servable for one extra epoch past the deprecation deadline.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Peer sends BlobsByRangeRequest at epoch FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. The condition evaluates false (blob_retention_epoch == fulu_fork_epoch), falls to default case, and serves deprecated blobs violating the protocol transition requirement.
